expected.note: Range 17:30–18:00 AEST ends 18:00 AEST = 08:00Z. In the data the last run issued before 07:30Z is stamped 2026-07-30T07:26:59Z.

expected.note: Target ends 17:00 AEST = 07:00Z. The request cutoff (16:00 AEST) governs; the question's own as-of (14:00 AEST = 04:00Z) must be shown as overridden. Data: under the 06:00Z cutoff the last run issued before 06:30Z that was already available is stamped 2026-07-31T02:56:58Z.
